title: Road trip to Song-Kol Lake
desc: We begin at the historic Burana Tower, then call on a Dungan family to share a traditional lagman lunch. From there the road climbs through Kochkor Village and over the Kalmak-Ashuu Pass at 3400 m.
By late afternoon you reach Song-Kol, high on its mountain plateau. A yurt waits on the shore, with time for a walk by the water before dinner and a night under wide-open skies.
meals: Lunch at guesthouse, dinner at yurt

title: Ride at Song-Kol & drive to Tash-Bashat
desc: The morning is for an easy horseback ride along the shore of Song-Kol, a gentle way to take in the lake and the nomad camps that dot the grassland.

After lunch you leave over the Terskey-Torpu Pass, with its dramatic zig-zag switchbacks, and drive on through Naryn to the rural village of Tash-Bashat. A comfortable hotel and an evening stroll round off the day.
meals: Breakfast & lunch at yurt, dinner at hotel

title: Trek to Kel-Suu Lake
desc: An early, rugged drive carries you through the At-Bashy region and over the Kyndy Pass at 3200 m into the remote Kok-Kiya Valley, where you leave your bags at the guesthouse.

From there a scenic trek follows the river to the spectacular Kel-Suu, a lake hidden among sheer cliffs. There is time to linger, perhaps take a boat out, before walking back for dinner and the night.
meals: Breakfast at hotel, lunch & dinner at guesthouse

title: Long drive to Ysyk-Kol
desc: This is the longest driving day of the trip. You retrace the route toward Naryn for fuel and lunch, then continue over the Dolon Pass at 3030 m and past Kochkor Village.
A short stop at the Ak-Say canyons breaks the journey before you arrive at a guesthouse in Bokonbaev, on the southern shore of Ysyk-Kol, by evening.
meals: Breakfast at guesthouse, lunch at restaurant, dinner at guesthouse

title: Explore the south shore of Ysyk-Kol
desc: The day opens with an eagle-hunter demonstration, then a visit to the dramatic rock formations of the Fairy-Tale Canyons. Lunch is with a well-known mountaineer's family in Tamga Village.
In the afternoon you take in the Barskoon Waterfalls and the striking red rock of the Jety-Oguz Valley before reaching Karakol for a short city tour.
meals: Breakfast & lunch at guesthouse, dinner at restaurant

title: Off-road to Altyn-Arashan Gorge
desc: Today you swap the car for a Soviet UAZ truck and rumble up a bumpy mountain track, following the river through dense pine forest into the Altyn-Arashan Gorge.
The afternoon is for soaking in the hot springs, wandering the trails, and taking in the view of Peak Palatka at 5200 m. Dinner and the night are at a simple guesthouse in the valley.
meals: Breakfast at hotel, lunch & dinner at guesthouse

title: Return to Bishkek
desc: A morning ride back down by UAZ brings you to Karakol for lunch at a local restaurant. From there the road home begins.
The route runs along the northern shore of Ysyk-Kol, the "Pearl of Central Asia," reaching Bishkek in the evening and bringing the road trip to a close.
meals: Breakfast at guesthouse, lunch at restaurant
